parameters.description: DWORD that specifies the style of the combo box. The following table shows the possible values. Value Description CBS_AUTOHSCROLL Automatically scrolls the text in an edit control to the right when the user types a character at the end of the line. If this style is not set, only text that fits within the rectangular boundary is enabled. CBS_DISABLENOSCROLL Shows a disabled vertical scroll bar in the list box when the box does not contain enough items to scroll. Without this style, the scroll bar is hidden when the list box does not contain enough items. CBS_DROPDOWN Displays only the edit control by default. The user can display the list box by selecting an icon next to the edit control. CBS

WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE Specifies that a window has a border with a sunken edge.
